payload.body: JUST IN - Trump says that after UAE, Saudi Arabia and Qatar asked him, he has agreed to hold off on the "planned Military attack" of Iran, "which was scheduled for tomorrow," as "serious negotiations are now taking place," and that he expects a deal to be made. Source: https://truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump/posts/116597121700043134 @disclosetv
